### `AmbientHorizontalTextAlignment`

```csharp
TextAlignment? AmbientHorizontalTextAlignment { get; set; }
```

The horizontal text alignment a `Container` establishes for descendant text that sets no alignment of its own. `null` means no ambient is in effect: unset text stays at its own default (Left). Scoped to the container's subtree by the container itself, which restores the value it found on the way in.

```csharp
ICanvas Canvas { get; }
```

*read-only*

Gets the current drawing canvas.

### `CellStretchHeight`

```csharp
float CellStretchHeight { get; set; }
```

The height `CellStretchTarget` fills: the row height less the cell's padding.

### `CellStretchTarget`

```csharp
Container CellStretchTarget { get; set; }
```

While a table draws a cell whose content is a `Container` (seen through pass-through wrappers), that container. It fills `CellStretchHeight`, so a border or background applied to a cell's content spans the whole row rather than only the cell's own text. `null` everywhere else; no other container is affected.

### `ChromeReservationSuspended`

```csharp
bool ChromeReservationSuspended { get; set; }
```

While `true`, `ContentTop` and `MaxY` ignore the chrome reservation. Set only while the engine paints the chrome itself: a header is not laid out inside the band it reserves for the body.

### `ContentBottom`

```csharp
float ContentBottom { get; }
```

*read-only*

Gets the bottom of the body content band: `PageSize.Height - max(Margin, footerHeight)`.

### `ContentHeight`

```csharp
float ContentHeight { get; }
```

*read-only*

Gets the usable body height on the current page: the full content band, not just what is left below the cursor. Elements use it to ask "would this fit on a fresh page at all?" before deciding to break rather than split.

### `ContentTop`

```csharp
float ContentTop { get; }
```

*read-only*

Gets the top of the body content band: `max(Margin, headerHeight)`. Chrome that fits inside the top margin reserves nothing beyond the margin the page already had, so this reduces to `Margin` for the overwhelming majority of documents.

## Methods

- [`FlushExternalCanvas`](#flushexternalcanvas): Composites a canvas obtained from `GetCanvas` into the currently active canvas.
- [`GetCanvas`](#getcanvas): Gets a canvas for a specific region or with specific offsets, writing to the current stream.
- [`GetFixedCanvas`](#getfixedcanvas): Gets a canvas for fixed/absolute positioning on the current page.
- [`GetImageResourceName`](#getimageresourcename): Returns the PDF resource name (e.g. `/Im1`) for a previously registered image.
- [`GetNewImageId`](#getnewimageid): Allocates and returns a new unique image object ID for use in the PDF cross-reference table.
- [`IsEmbeddedFont`](#isembeddedfont): Returns `true` if the given font identifier refers to an embedded TrueType font rather than one of the 14 standard PDF fonts.
- [`NewPage`](#newpage): Creates a new page and resets the cursor position
- [`RefreshChromeReservation`](#refreshchromereservation): Re-measures the current page's chrome.
- [`RegisterAlphaGraphicsState`](#registeralphagraphicsstate): Registers a reusable PDF transparency graphics state for the given alpha value.
- [`RegisterDeferredXObject`](#registerdeferredxobject): Registers a deferred Form XObject for a watermark or overlay pattern and returns its PDF resource name.
- [`RegisterFont`](#registerfont): Registers a font by its identifier and returns the PDF resource name (e.g. `/F1`) to use in content stream operators.
- [`RegisterImage`](#registerimage): Registers an image with the resource registry and returns its assigned object ID.
- [`ResetCursorToContentTop`](#resetcursortocontenttop): Moves the cursor to the top-left of the current page's body content band.
- [`SetCanvas`](#setcanvas): Temporarily sets the canvas to a specific instance.
- [`SwitchToPage`](#switchtopage): Switches to a specific page by index

### `RefreshChromeReservation`

```csharp
void RefreshChromeReservation()
```

Re-measures the current page's chrome. Called on every page switch and every page break; the pipelines also call it after assigning a new page size or margin, because those change the width the chrome is measured against.

### `RegisterAlphaGraphicsState`

```csharp
string RegisterAlphaGraphicsState(float alpha)
```

Registers a reusable PDF transparency graphics state for the given alpha value.

### `RegisterDeferredXObject`

```csharp
string RegisterDeferredXObject(string fontFamily, float fontSize, Color color)
```

Registers a deferred Form XObject for a watermark or overlay pattern and returns its PDF resource name. The XObject content is generated at the end of the document.

### `RegisterFont`

```csharp
string RegisterFont(string fontIdentifier)
```

Registers a font by its identifier and returns the PDF resource name (e.g. `/F1`) to use in content stream operators.

### `RegisterImage`

```csharp
int RegisterImage(ImageInfo info)
```

Registers an image with the resource registry and returns its assigned object ID. Identical images are de-duplicated automatically.

### `ResetCursorToContentTop`

```csharp
void ResetCursorToContentTop()
```

Moves the cursor to the top-left of the current page's body content band.
